lessons.title: By the Names Every Prophet Called Upon You

items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ أَسْأَلُكَ بِالْأَسْمَاءِ الْعِظَامِ الَّتِي سَمَّيْتَ بِهَا نَفْسَكَ، مَا عَلِمْتُ مِنْهَا وَمَا لَمْ أَعْلَمْ. وَأَسْأَلُكَ بِالْأَسْمَاءِ الَّتِي دَعَاكَ بِهَا سَيِّدُنَا آدَمُ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ، وَبِالْأَسْمَاءِ الَّتِي دَعَاكَ بِهَا سَيِّدُنَا نُوحٌ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ، وَبِالْأَسْمَاءِ الَّتِي دَعَاكَ بِهَا سَيِّدُنَا هُودٌ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ، وَبِالْأَسْمَاءِ الَّتِي دَعَاكَ بِهَا سَيِّدُنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ، وَبِالْأَسْمَاءِ الَّتِي دَعَاكَ بِهَا سَيِّدُنَا صَالِحٌ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ.
items.en: O Allah, I ask You by the Great Names by which You have named Yourself, those I know of them and those I do not know. And I ask You by the names by which our master Adam called upon You, peace be upon him; and by the names by which our master Nuh called upon You, peace be upon him; and by the names by which our master Hud called upon You, peace be upon him; and by the names by which our master Ibrahim called upon You, peace be upon him; and by the names by which our master Salih called upon You, peace be upon him.
items.translit: Allahumma as'aluka bil-asma'il-'izami-llati sammayta biha nafsak, ma 'alimtu minha wa ma lam a'lam. Wa as'aluka bil-asma'il-lati da'aka biha Sayyiduna Adamu 'alayhis-salam, wa bil-asma'il-lati da'aka biha Sayyiduna Nuhun 'alayhis-salam, wa bil-asma'il-lati da'aka biha Sayyiduna Hudun 'alayhis-salam, wa bil-asma'il-lati da'aka biha Sayyiduna Ibrahimu 'alayhis-salam, wa bil-asma'il-lati da'aka biha Sayyiduna Salihun 'alayhis-salam.

items.ar: وَبِالْأَسْمَاءِ الَّتِي دَعَاكَ بِهَا سَيِّدُنَا يُونُسُ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ، وَبِالْأَسْمَاءِ الَّتِي دَعَاكَ بِهَا سَيِّدُنَا أَيُّوبُ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ، وَبِالْأَسْمَاءِ الَّتِي دَعَاكَ بِهَا سَيِّدُنَا يَعْقُوبُ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ، وَبِالْأَسْمَاءِ الَّتِي دَعَاكَ بِهَا سَيِّدُنَا يُوسُفُ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ، وَبِالْأَسْمَاءِ الَّتِي دَعَاكَ بِهَا سَيِّدُنَا مُوسَى عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ.
items.en: And by the names by which our master Yunus called upon You, peace be upon him; and by the names by which our master Ayyub called upon You, peace be upon him; and by the names by which our master Ya'qub called upon You, peace be upon him; and by the names by which our master Yusuf called upon You, peace be upon him; and by the names by which our master Musa called upon You, peace be upon him.
items.translit: Wa bil-asma'il-lati da'aka biha Sayyiduna Yunusu 'alayhis-salam, wa bil-asma'il-lati da'aka biha Sayyiduna Ayyubu 'alayhis-salam, wa bil-asma'il-lati da'aka biha Sayyiduna Ya'qubu 'alayhis-salam, wa bil-asma'il-lati da'aka biha Sayyiduna Yusufu 'alayhis-salam, wa bil-asma'il-lati da'aka biha Sayyiduna Musa 'alayhis-salam.

items.ar: وَبِالْأَسْمَاءِ الَّتِي دَعَاكَ بِهَا سَيِّدُنَا هَارُونُ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ، وَبِالْأَسْمَاءِ الَّتِي دَعَاكَ بِهَا سَيِّدُنَا شُعَيْبٌ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ، وَبِالْأَسْمَاءِ الَّتِي دَعَاكَ بِهَا سَيِّدُنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ، وَبِالْأَسْمَاءِ الَّتِي دَعَاكَ بِهَا سَيِّدُنَا دَاوُدُ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ، وَبِالْأَسْمَاءِ الَّتِي دَعَاكَ بِهَا سَيِّدُنَا سُلَيْمَانُ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ.
items.en: And by the names by which our master Harun called upon You, peace be upon him; and by the names by which our master Shu'ayb called upon You, peace be upon him; and by the names by which our master Isma'il called upon You, peace be upon him; and by the names by which our master Dawud called upon You, peace be upon him; and by the names by which our master Sulayman called upon You, peace be upon him.
items.translit: Wa bil-asma'il-lati da'aka biha Sayyiduna Harunu 'alayhis-salam, wa bil-asma'il-lati da'aka biha Sayyiduna Shu'aybun 'alayhis-salam, wa bil-asma'il-lati da'aka biha Sayyiduna Isma'ilu 'alayhis-salam, wa bil-asma'il-lati da'aka biha Sayyiduna Dawudu 'alayhis-salam, wa bil-asma'il-lati da'aka biha Sayyiduna Sulaymanu 'alayhis-salam.

items.ar: وَبِالْأَسْمَاءِ الَّتِي دَعَاكَ بِهَا سَيِّدُنَا زَكَرِيَّا عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ، وَبِالْأَسْمَاءِ الَّتِي دَعَاكَ بِهَا سَيِّدُنَا يَحْيَى عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ، وَبِالْأَسْمَاءِ الَّتِي دَعَاكَ بِهَا سَيِّدُنَا إِرْمِيَاءُ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ، وَبِالْأَسْمَاءِ الَّتِي دَعَاكَ بِهَا سَيِّدُنَا شَعْيَاءُ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ، وَبِالْأَسْمَاءِ الَّتِي دَعَاكَ بِهَا سَيِّدُنَا إِلْيَاسُ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ.
items.en: And by the names by which our master Zakariya called upon You, peace be upon him; and by the names by which our master Yahya called upon You, peace be upon him; and by the names by which our master Armiya called upon You, peace be upon him; and by the names by which our master Sha'ya called upon You, peace be upon him; and by the names by which our master Ilyas called upon You, peace be upon him.
items.translit: Wa bil-asma'il-lati da'aka biha Sayyiduna Zakariyya 'alayhis-salam, wa bil-asma'il-lati da'aka biha Sayyiduna Yahya 'alayhis-salam, wa bil-asma'il-lati da'aka biha Sayyiduna Irmiya'u 'alayhis-salam, wa bil-asma'il-lati da'aka biha Sayyiduna Sha'ya'u 'alayhis-salam, wa bil-asma'il-lati da'aka biha Sayyiduna Ilyasu 'alayhis-salam.

items.ar: وَبِالْأَسْمَاءِ الَّتِي دَعَاكَ بِهَا سَيِّدُنَا الْيَسَعُ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ، وَبِالْأَسْمَاءِ الَّتِي دَعَاكَ بِهَا سَيِّدُنَا ذُو الْكِفْلِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ، وَبِالْأَسْمَاءِ الَّتِي دَعَاكَ بِهَا سَيِّدُنَا يُوشَعُ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ، وَبِالْأَسْمَاءِ الَّتِي دَعَاكَ بِهَا سَيِّدُنَا عِيسَى ابْنُ مَرْيَمَ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ، وَبِالْأَسْمَاءِ الَّتِي دَعَاكَ بِهَا سَيِّدُنَا مُحَمَّدٌ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ.
items.en: And by the names by which our master al-Yasa' called upon You, peace be upon him; and by the names by which our master Dhul-Kifl called upon You, peace be upon him; and by the names by which our master Yusha' called upon You, peace be upon him; and by the names by which our master 'Isa, son of Maryam, called upon You, peace be upon him; and by the names by which our master Muhammad called upon You, may Allah's blessings and peace be upon him.
items.translit: Wa bil-asma'il-lati da'aka biha Sayyidunal-Yasa'u 'alayhis-salam, wa bil-asma'il-lati da'aka biha Sayyiduna Dhul-Kifli 'alayhis-salam, wa bil-asma'il-lati da'aka biha Sayyiduna Yusha'u 'alayhis-salam, wa bil-asma'il-lati da'aka biha Sayyiduna 'Isabnu Maryama 'alayhis-salam, wa bil-asma'il-lati da'aka biha Sayyiduna Muhammadun sallallahu 'alayhi wa sallam.

items.ar: وَعَلَى جَمِيعِ النَّبِيِّينَ وَالْمُرْسَلِينَ، أَنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ نَبِيِّكَ، عَدَدَ مَا خَلَقْتَهُ مِنْ قَبْلِ أَنْ تَكُونَ السَّمَاءُ مَبْنِيَّةً وَالْجِبَالُ مُرْسَاةً وَالْعُيُونُ مُنْفَجِرَةً وَالْأَنْهَارُ مُنْهَمِرَةً وَالشَّمْسُ مُضْحِيَةً وَالْقَمَرُ مُضِيئًا وَالْكَوَاكِبُ مُسْتَنِيرَةً، كُنْتَ حَيْثُ كُنْتَ لَا يَعْلَمُ أَحَدٌ حَيْثُ كُنْتَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ وَحْدَكَ لَا شَرِيكَ لَكَ.
items.en: And upon all the prophets and messengers, that You send blessings upon our master Muhammad, Your Prophet, as many as You created before the sky was built, the mountains anchored, the springs made to burst forth, the rivers made to pour down, the sun made to shine by day, the moon made luminous, and the stars made radiant. You were where You were; none knows where You were except You alone, with no partner.
items.translit: Wa 'ala jami'in-nabiyyina wal-mursalin, an tusalliya 'ala Sayyidina Muhammadin nabiyyika, 'adada ma khalaqtahu min qabli an takunas-sama'u mabniyyatan wal-jibalu mursatan wal-'uyunu munfajiratan wal-anharu munhamiratan wash-shamsu mudh-hiyatan wal-qamaru mudhi'an wal-kawakibu mustanirah, kunta haythu kunta la ya'lamu ahadun haythu kunta illa anta wahdaka la sharika lak.

lessons.title: As Many as Every Drop and Every Breath

items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ عِلْمِكَ وَعَدَدَ كَلِمَاتِكَ وَعَدَدَ نِعْمَتِكَ، وَصَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ مِلْءَ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَمِلْءَ الْأَرْضِ وَمِلْءَ الْعَرْشِ وَزِنَةَ الْعَرْشِ، وَصَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ مَا جَرَى بِهِ الْقَلَمُ فِي أُمِّ الْكِتَابِ، وَصَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ مَا خَلَقْتَ فِي سَبْعِ سَمَاوَاتٍ وَعَدَدَ مَا أَنْتَ خَالِقٌ فِيهِنَّ إِلَى يَوْمِ الْقِيَامَةِ فِي كُلِّ يَوْمٍ أَلْفَ مَرَّةٍ.
items.en: O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad as many as Your knowledge, and as many as Your words, and as many as Your favor; and send blessings upon our master Muhammad, filling the heavens and filling the earth and filling the Throne, and the weight of the Throne; and send blessings upon our master Muhammad as many as the Pen has recorded in the Mother of the Book; and send blessings upon our master Muhammad as many as You have created in the seven heavens and as many as You will create in them until the Day of Resurrection, a thousand times every day.
items.translit: Allahumma salli 'ala Sayyidina Muhammadin 'adada 'ilmika wa 'adada kalimatika wa 'adada ni'matik, wa salli 'ala Sayyidina Muhammadin mil'as-samawati wa mil'al-ardhi wa mil'al-'arshi wa zinatal-'arsh, wa salli 'ala Sayyidina Muhammadin 'adada ma jara bihil-qalamu fi ummil-kitab, wa salli 'ala Sayyidina Muhammadin 'adada ma khalaqta fi sab'i samawatin wa 'adada ma anta khaliqun fihinna ila yawmil-qiyamati fi kulli yawmin alfa marrah.

items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ كُلِّ قَطْرَةٍ قَطَرَتْ مِنْ سَمَاوَاتِكَ إِلَى أَرْضِكَ مِنْ مَرَّةٍ، وَعَدَدَ مَنْ يُسَبِّحُكَ وَيُهَلِّلُكَ وَيُكَبِّرُكَ وَيُعَظِّمُكَ مِنْ يَوْمِ خَلَقْتَ الدُّنْيَا إِلَى يَوْمِ الْقِيَامَةِ فِي كُلِّ يَوْمٍ أَلْفَ مَرَّةٍ، وَعَدَدَ أَنْفَاسِهِمْ وَأَلْفَاظِهِمْ وَعَدَدَ كُلِّ نَسَمَةٍ خَلَقْتَهَا فِيهِمْ، وَعَدَدَ السَّحَابِ الْجَارِيَةِ وَالرِّيَاحِ الذَّارِيَةِ مِنْ يَوْمِ خَلَقْتَ الدُّنْيَا إِلَى يَوْمِ الْقِيَامَةِ فِي كُلِّ يَوْمٍ أَلْفَ مَرَّةٍ.
items.en: O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad as many times as every drop that has fallen from Your heavens to Your earth, and as many as those who glorify You, declare Your Oneness, magnify You, and exalt You from the day You created the world until the Day of Resurrection, a thousand times every day, and as many as their breaths and their utterances and every soul You created among them, and as many as the flowing clouds and the scattering winds, from the day You created the world until the Day of Resurrection, a thousand times every day.
items.translit: Allahumma salli 'ala Sayyidina Muhammadin 'adada kulli qatratin qatarat min samawatika ila ardhika min marrah, wa 'adada man yusabbihuka wa yuhalliluka wa yukabbiruka wa yu'azzimuka min yawmi khalaqtad-dunya ila yawmil-qiyamati fi kulli yawmin alfa marrah, wa 'adada anfasihim wa alfazihim wa 'adada kulli nasamatin khalaqtaha fihim, wa 'adadas-sahabil-jariyati war-riyahidh-dhariyati min yawmi khalaqtad-dunya ila yawmil-qiyamati fi kulli yawmin alfa marrah.

items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ مِلْءَ أَرْضِكَ وَعَدَدَ مَا خَلَقْتَ فِي بِحَارِكَ السَّبْعَةِ مِمَّا لَا يَعْلَمُ عِلْمَهُ إِلَّا أَنْتَ، وَعَدَدَ نَبَاتِ الْأَرْضِ فِي مَشَارِقِهَا وَمَغَارِبِهَا وَجِبَالِهَا وَأَوْدِيَتِهَا وَأَشْجَارِهَا وَثِمَارِهَا، وَعَدَدَ مَا خَلَقْتَ مِنَ الْجِنِّ وَالْإِنْسِ وَالشَّيَاطِينِ، وَعَدَدَ كُلِّ شَعْرَةٍ فِي أَبْدَانِهِمْ وَوُجُوهِهِمْ، وَعَدَدَ خَفَقَانِ الطَّيْرِ وَطَيَرَانِ الْجِنِّ وَالشَّيَاطِينِ، وَعَدَدَ كُلِّ بَهِيمَةٍ خَلَقْتَهَا صَغِيرَةً أَوْ كَبِيرَةً، وَعَدَدَ خُطَاهُمْ عَلَى وَجْهِ الْأَرْضِ، مِنْ يَوْمِ خَلَقْتَ الدُّنْيَا إِلَى يَوْمِ الْقِيَامَةِ فِي كُلِّ يَوْمٍ أَلْفَ مَرَّةٍ.
items.en: O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, filling Your earth, and as many as what You created in Your seven seas which none knows except You, and as many as the plants of the earth in its east and west, its mountains and valleys, its trees and its fruits, and as many as what You created of jinn, humans, and devils, and as many as every hair on their bodies and faces, and as many as the flapping of birds and the flying of jinn and devils, and as many as every creature You created, small or large, and as many as their footsteps upon the face of the earth, from the day You created the world until the Day of Resurrection, a thousand times every day.
items.translit: Allahumma salli 'ala Sayyidina Muhammadin mil'a ardhika wa 'adada ma khalaqta fi biharikas-sab'ati mimma la ya'lamu 'ilmahu illa ant, wa 'adada nabatil-ardhi fi mashariqiha wa magharibiha wa jibaliha wa awdiyatiha wa ashjariha wa thimariha, wa 'adada ma khalaqta minal-jinni wal-insi wash-shayatin, wa 'adada kulli sha'ratin fi abdanihim wa wujuhihim, wa 'adada khafaqanit-tayri wa tayaranil-jinni wash-shayatin, wa 'adada kulli bahimatin khalaqtaha saghiratan aw kabiratan, wa 'adada khutahum 'ala wajhil-ardhi, min yawmi khalaqtad-dunya ila yawmil-qiyamati fi kulli yawmin alfa marrah.

items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ مَنْ يُصَلِّي عَلَيْهِ، وَصَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ الْقَطْرِ وَالْمَطَرِ وَالنَّبَاتِ، وَصَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ، وَصَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ فِي اللَّيْلِ إِذَا يَغْشَى وَفِي النَّهَارِ إِذَا تَجَلَّى، وَصَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ فِي الْآخِرَةِ وَالْأُولَى، وَصَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ شَعْبًا زَكِيًّا وَخَلًّا مَرْضِيًّا، مُنْذُ كَانَ فِي الْمَهْدِ صَبِيًّا، حَتَّى لَا يَبْقَى مِنَ الصَّلَاةِ شَيْءٌ.
items.en: O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad as many as those who send blessings upon him, and send blessings upon our master Muhammad as many as the drops, the rain, and the vegetation, and send blessings upon our master Muhammad as many as everything, and send blessings upon our master Muhammad in the night when it covers and in the day when it appears in glory, and send blessings upon our master Muhammad in the last life and the first, and send blessings upon our master Muhammad, a pure people and a pleasing friend, from when he was a child in the cradle, until nothing remains of blessing.
items.translit: Allahumma salli 'ala Sayyidina Muhammadin 'adada man yusalli 'alayh, wa salli 'ala Sayyidina Muhammadin 'adadal-qatri wal-matari wan-nabat, wa salli 'ala Sayyidina Muhammadin 'adada kulli shay', wa salli 'ala Sayyidina Muhammadin fil-layli idha yaghsha wa fin-nahari idha tajalla, wa salli 'ala Sayyidina Muhammadin fil-akhirati wal-ula, wa salli 'ala Sayyidina Muhammadin sha'ban zakiyyan wa khallan mardhiyyan, mundhu kana fil-mahdi sabiyyan, hatta la yabqa minas-salati shay'.

lessons.title: The Praised Station and Its Reward

items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ وَآتِ سَيِّدَنَا مُحَمَّدًا الْمَقَامَ الْمَحْمُودَ الَّذِي وَعَدْتَهُ الَّذِي إِذَا قَالَ صَدَّقْتَهُ وَإِذَا سَأَلَ أَعْطَيْتَ. اللَّهُمَّ عَظِّمْ بُرْهَانَهُ وَشَرِّفْ بُنْيَانَهُ وَأَبْلِجْ حُجَّتَهُ وَبَيِّنْ فَضِيلَتَهُ. اللَّهُمَّ تَقَبَّلْ شَفَاعَتَهُ فِي أُمَّتِهِ، وَاسْتَعْمِلْنَا بِسُنَّتِهِ وَتَوَفَّنَا عَلَى مِلَّتِهِ وَاحْشُرْنَا فِي زُمْرَتِهِ وَتَحْتَ لِوَائِهِ، وَاجْعَلْنَا مِنْ رُفَقَائِهِ، وَأَوْرِدْنَا حَوْضَهُ وَاسْقِنَا بِكَأْسِهِ وَانْفَعْنَا بِمَحَبَّتِهِ. اللَّهُمَّ آمِينَ.
items.en: O Allah, grant our master Muhammad the Praised Station which You promised him, the one whose word You confirm and whose request You grant when he asks. O Allah, magnify his proof, honor his structure, make manifest his argument, and make clear his excellence. O Allah, accept his intercession for his nation, and employ us by his way, and take our souls upon his religion, and gather us in his company and beneath his banner, and make us among his companions, and bring us to his Pool, and give us to drink from his cup, and benefit us through love of him. O Allah, amen.
items.translit: Allahumma wa ati Sayyidana Muhammadanil-maqamal-mahmudal-ladhi wa'adtahul-ladhi idha qala saddaqtahu wa idha sa'ala a'tayt. Allahumma 'azzim burhanahu wa sharrif bunyanahu wa ablij hujjatahu wa bayyin fadhilatah. Allahumma taqabbal shafa'atahu fi ummatihi, wasta'milna bi-sunnatihi wa tawaffana 'ala millatihi wahshurna fi zumratihi wa tahta liwa'ihi, waj'alna min rufaqa'ihi, wa awridna hawdahu wasqina bika'sihi wanfa'na bi-mahabbatih. Allahumma amin.

items.ar: وَأَسْأَلُكَ بِأَسْمَائِكَ الَّتِي دَعَوْتُكَ بِهَا أَنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ مَا وَصَفْتُ مِمَّا لَا يَعْلَمُ عِلْمَهُ إِلَّا أَنْتَ، وَأَنْ تَرْحَمَنِي وَتَتُوبَ عَلَيَّ وَتُعَافِيَنِي مِنْ جَمِيعِ الْبَلَاءِ وَالْبَلْوَى، وَأَنْ تَغْفِرَ لِي وَلِوَالِدَيَّ وَتَرْحَمَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَالْمُؤْمِنَاتِ وَالْمُسْلِمِينَ وَالْمُسْلِمَاتِ الْأَحْيَاءَ مِنْهُمْ وَالْأَمْوَاتَ.
items.en: And I ask You by Your names by which I have called upon You, to send blessings upon our master Muhammad as many as I have described, of what none knows except You, and to have mercy on me, accept my repentance, and grant me well-being from every trial and affliction, and to forgive me and my parents and have mercy on the believing men and women and Muslim men and women, the living among them and the dead.
items.translit: Wa as'aluka bi-asma'ikal-lati da'awtuka biha an tusalliya 'ala Sayyidina Muhammadin 'adada ma wasaftu mimma la ya'lamu 'ilmahu illa ant, wa an tarhamani wa tatuba 'alayya wa tu'afiyani min jami'il-bala'i wal-balwa, wa an taghfira li wa li-walidayya wa tarhamal-mu'minina wal-mu'minati wal-muslimina wal-muslimatil-ahya'a minhum wal-amwat.

items.ar: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ: مَنْ قَرَأَ هَذِهِ الصَّلَاةَ مَرَّةً وَاحِدَةً كَتَبَ اللَّهُ لَهُ ثَوَابَ حَجَّةٍ مَقْبُولَةٍ، فَيَقُولُ اللَّهُ تَعَالَى: يَا مَلَائِكَتِي، هَذَا عَبْدٌ مِنْ عِبَادِي أَكْثَرَ الصَّلَاةَ عَلَى حَبِيبِي مُحَمَّدٍ، فَوَعِزَّتِي وَجَلَالِي، لَأُعْطِيَنَّهُ بِكُلِّ حَرْفٍ صَلَّى بِهِ قَصْرًا فِي الْجَنَّةِ، وَنُورُ وَجْهِهِ كَالْقَمَرِ لَيْلَةَ الْبَدْرِ، وَكَفُّهُ فِي كَفِّ حَبِيبِي مُحَمَّدٍ.
items.en: The Messenger of Allah, may Allah bless him and grant him peace, said: whoever reads this blessing a single time, Allah will record for him the reward of an accepted pilgrimage. So Allah, the Exalted, says: O My angels, this is a servant among My servants who has multiplied blessings upon My beloved Muhammad; so by My might and My majesty, I shall grant him, for every letter he has blessed with, a palace in Paradise, the light of his face like the moon on the night it is full, and his hand in the hand of My beloved Muhammad.
items.translit: Qala Rasulullahi sallallahu 'alayhi wa sallam: man qara'a hadhihis-salata marratan wahidatan kataballahu lahu thawaba hajjatin maqbulah, fa-yaqulullahu ta'ala: ya mala'ikati, hadha 'abdun min 'ibadi akthara as-salata 'ala habibi Muhammadin, fa-wa 'izzati wa jalali, la-u'tiyannahu bi-kulli harfin salla bihi qasran fil-jannah, wa nuru wajhihi kal-qamari laylatal-badr, wa kaffuhu fi kaffi habibi Muhammad.

items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ بِحَقِّ مَا حَمَلَ كُرْسِيُّكَ مِنْ عَظَمَتِكَ وَقُدْرَتِكَ وَجَلَالِكَ وَبَهَائِكَ وَسُلْطَانِكَ، وَبِحَقِّ اسْمِكَ الْمَخْزُونِ الْمَكْنُونِ الَّذِي سَمَّيْتَ بِهِ نَفْسَكَ وَأَنْزَلْتَهُ فِي كِتَابِكَ وَاسْتَأْثَرْتَ بِهِ فِي عِلْمِ الْغَيْبِ عِنْدَكَ، أَنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَبْدِكَ وَرَسُولِكَ.
items.en: O Allah, I ask You by the right of what Your Chair bears of Your greatness, Your power, Your majesty, Your splendor, and Your dominion, and by the right of Your treasured, hidden Name by which You named Yourself and which You sent down in Your Book and reserved for Yourself in the knowledge of the unseen, to send blessings upon our master Muhammad, Your servant and Your messenger.
items.translit: Allahumma inni as'aluka bi-haqqi ma hamala kursiyyuka min 'azamatika wa qudratika wa jalalika wa baha'ika wa sultanika, wa bi-haqqi ismikal-makhzunil-maknunil-ladhi sammayta bihi nafsaka wa anzaltahu fi kitabika wasta'tharta bihi fi 'ilmil-ghaybi 'indak, an tusalliya 'ala Sayyidina Muhammadin 'abdika wa rasulik.

items.ar: وَأَسْأَلُكَ بِاسْمِكَ الَّذِي إِذَا دُعِيتَ بِهِ أَجَبْتَ وَإِذَا سُئِلْتَ بِهِ أَعْطَيْتَ، وَأَسْأَلُكَ بِاسْمِكَ الَّذِي وَضَعْتَهُ عَلَى اللَّيْلِ فَأَظْلَمَ وَعَلَى النَّهَارِ فَاسْتَنَارَ وَعَلَى السَّمَاوَاتِ فَاسْتَقَلَّتْ وَعَلَى الْأَرْضِ فَاسْتَقَرَّتْ وَعَلَى الْجِبَالِ فَأَرْسَتْ وَعَلَى الصَّعْبِ فَذَلَّتْ وَعَلَى مَاءِ السَّمَاءِ فَسُكِبَتْ وَعَلَى السَّحَابِ فَأَمْطَرَتْ.
items.en: And I ask You by Your Name which, when called upon by it, You answer, and when asked by it, You give; and I ask You by Your Name which You placed upon the night and it grew dark, and upon the day and it shone with light, and upon the heavens and they became lifted, and upon the earth and it became settled, and upon the mountains and they became anchored, and upon the difficult and it became easy, and upon the water of the sky and it was poured, and upon the clouds and they rained.
items.translit: Wa as'aluka bismikal-ladhi idha du'ita bihi ajabta wa idha su'ilta bihi a'tayt, wa as'aluka bismikal-ladhi wadha'tahu 'alal-layli fa-azlam wa 'alan-nahari fastanara wa 'alas-samawati fastaqallat wa 'alal-ardhi fastaqarrat wa 'alal-jibali fa-arsat wa 'alas-sa'bi fa-dhallat wa 'ala ma'is-sama'i fa-sukibat wa 'alas-sahabi fa-amtarat.

items.ar: وَأَسْأَلُكَ بِمَا سَأَلَكَ بِهِ سَيِّدُنَا مُحَمَّدٌ النَّبِيُّ، وَأَسْأَلُكَ بِمَا سَأَلَكَ بِهِ سَيِّدُنَا آدَمُ النَّبِيُّ، وَأَسْأَلُكَ بِمَا سَأَلَكَ بِهِ أَنْبِيَاؤُكَ وَرُسُلُكَ وَمَلَائِكَتُكَ الْمُقَرَّبُونَ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِمْ أَجْمَعِينَ، وَأَسْأَلُكَ بِمَا سَأَلَكَ بِهِ أَهْلُ طَاعَتِكَ أَجْمَعِينَ، أَنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ مَا خَلَقْتَ مِنْ قَبْلِ أَنْ تَكُونَ السَّمَاءُ مَبْنِيَّةً وَالْأَرْضُ مُدْحِيَّةً وَالْجِبَالُ مُرْسَاةً.
items.en: And I ask You by what our master Muhammad the Prophet asked You, and I ask You by what our master Adam the Prophet asked You, and I ask You by what Your prophets, Your messengers, and Your angels brought near asked You, Allah's blessings be upon them all, and I ask You by what all the people of Your obedience asked You, to send blessings upon our master Muhammad and upon the family of our master Muhammad, as many as You created before the sky was built, the earth spread out, and the mountains anchored.
items.translit: Wa as'aluka bima sa'alaka bihi Sayyiduna Muhammadunin-nabiyy, wa as'aluka bima sa'alaka bihi Sayyiduna Adamun-nabiyy, wa as'aluka bima sa'alaka bihi anbiya'uka wa rusuluka wa mala'ikatukal-muqarrabuna sallallahu 'alayhim ajma'in, wa as'aluka bima sa'alaka bihi ahlu ta'atika ajma'in, an tusalliya 'ala Sayyidina Muhammadin wa 'ala ali Sayyidina Muhammadin 'adada ma khalaqta min qabli an takunas-sama'u mabniyyatan wal-ardhu mudhiyyatan wal-jibalu mursatan.

items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ عِلْمِكَ وَعَدَدَ حِلْمِكَ وَعَدَدَ مَا أَحْصَاهُ اللَّوْحُ الْمَحْفُوظُ مِنْ عِلْمِكَ، وَعَدَدَ مَا جَرَى بِهِ الْقَلَمُ فِي أُمِّ الْكِتَابِ عِنْدَكَ، وَمِلْءَ سَمَاوَاتِكَ وَمِلْءَ أَرْضِكَ وَمِلْءَ مَا أَنْتَ خَالِقُهُ مِنْ يَوْمِ خَلَقْتَ الدُّنْيَا إِلَى يَوْمِ الْقِيَامَةِ.
items.en: O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad and upon the family of our master Muhammad, as many as Your knowledge, and as many as Your forbearance, and as many as the Preserved Tablet has recorded of Your knowledge, and as many as the Pen has recorded in the Mother of the Book with You, and filling Your heavens and filling Your earth and filling what You will create from the day You created the world until the Day of Resurrection.
items.translit: Allahumma salli 'ala Sayyidina Muhammadin wa 'ala ali Sayyidina Muhammadin 'adada 'ilmika wa 'adada hilmika wa 'adada ma ahsahul-lawhul-mahfuzu min 'ilmik, wa 'adada ma jara bihil-qalamu fi ummil-kitabi 'indak, wa mil'a samawatika wa mil'a ardhika wa mil'a ma anta khaliquhu min yawmi khalaqtad-dunya ila yawmil-qiyamah.

items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ صُفُوفِ الْمَلَائِكَةِ وَتَسْبِيحِهِمْ وَتَقْدِيسِهِمْ وَتَمْجِيدِهِمْ وَتَكْبِيرِهِمْ وَتَهْلِيلِهِمْ مِنْ يَوْمِ خَلَقْتَ الدُّنْيَا إِلَى يَوْمِ الْقِيَامَةِ، وَعَدَدَ السَّحَابِ الْجَارِيَةِ وَالرِّيَاحِ الذَّارِيَةِ، وَعَدَدَ كُلِّ قَطْرَةٍ تَقْطُرُ مِنْ سَمَاوَاتِكَ إِلَى أَرْضِكَ، وَعَدَدَ مَا هَبَّتْ بِهِ الرِّيَاحُ وَتَحَرَّكَتْ بِهِ الْأَشْجَارُ وَالْأَوْرَاقُ وَالزُّرُوعُ، وَعَدَدَ الْقَطْرِ وَالْمَطَرِ وَالنَّبَاتِ، وَعَدَدَ النُّجُومِ فِي السَّمَاءِ، وَعَدَدَ مَا خَلَقْتَ فِي بِحَارِكَ السَّبْعَةِ مِمَّا لَا يَعْلَمُ عِلْمَهُ إِلَّا أَنْتَ.
items.en: O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad and upon the family of our master Muhammad, as many as the ranks of the angels and their glorification, their sanctification, their magnification, their exaltation, and their declaration of Your Oneness from the day You created the world until the Day of Resurrection, and as many as the flowing clouds and the scattering winds, and as many as every drop that falls from Your heavens to Your earth, and as many as what the winds have stirred and the trees, leaves, and crops have moved by, and as many as the drops, the rain, and the vegetation, and as many as the stars in the sky, and as many as what You created in Your seven seas which none knows except You.
items.translit: Allahumma salli 'ala Sayyidina Muhammadin wa 'ala ali Sayyidina Muhammadin 'adada sufufil-mala'ikati wa tasbihihim wa taqdisihim wa tamjidihim wa takbirihim wa tahlilihim min yawmi khalaqtad-dunya ila yawmil-qiyamah, wa 'adadas-sahabil-jariyati war-riyahidh-dhariyah, wa 'adada kulli qatratin taqturu min samawatika ila ardhik, wa 'adada ma habbat bihir-riyahu wa taharrakat bihil-ashjaru wal-awraqu waz-zuru', wa 'adadal-qatri wal-matari wan-nabat, wa 'adadan-nujumi fis-sama', wa 'adada ma khalaqta fi biharikas-sab'ati mimma la ya'lamu 'ilmahu illa ant.

items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ الرَّمْلِ وَالْحَصَى فِي مَشَارِقِ الْأَرْضِ وَمَغَارِبِهَا، وَعَدَدَ مَا خَلَقْتَ مِنَ الْجِنِّ وَالْإِنْسِ، وَعَدَدَ أَنْفَاسِهِمْ وَأَلْفَاظِهِمْ وَلَحَظَاتِهِمْ، وَعَدَدَ طَيَرَانِ الْجِنِّ وَالْمَلَائِكَةِ، وَعَدَدَ الطُّيُورِ وَالْهَوَامِّ وَالْوُحُوشِ فِي مَشَارِقِ الْأَرْضِ وَمَغَارِبِهَا، وَعَدَدَ الْأَحْيَاءِ وَالْأَمْوَاتِ، وَعَدَدَ مَا أَظْلَمَ عَلَيْهِ اللَّيْلُ وَأَشْرَقَ عَلَيْهِ النَّهَارُ، وَعَدَدَ مَنْ يَمْشِي عَلَى رِجْلَيْنِ وَمَنْ يَمْشِي عَلَى أَرْبَعٍ، مِنْ يَوْمِ خَلَقْتَ الدُّنْيَا إِلَى يَوْمِ الْقِيَامَةِ.
items.en: O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad and upon the family of our master Muhammad, as many as the sand and pebbles in the east and west of the earth, and as many as what You created of jinn and humans, and as many as their breaths, their utterances, and their glances, and as many as the flight of jinn and angels, and as many as the birds, crawling creatures, and wild beasts in the east and west of the earth, and as many as the living and the dead, and as many as what night has darkened over and day has shone upon, and as many as those who walk on two legs and those who walk on four, from the day You created the world until the Day of Resurrection.
items.translit: Allahumma salli 'ala Sayyidina Muhammadin wa 'ala ali Sayyidina Muhammadin 'adadar-ramli wal-hasa fi mashariqil-ardhi wa magharibiha, wa 'adada ma khalaqta minal-jinni wal-ins, wa 'adada anfasihim wa alfazihim wa lahazatihim, wa 'adada tayaranil-jinni wal-mala'ikah, wa 'adadat-tuyuri wal-hawammi wal-wuhushi fi mashariqil-ardhi wa magharibiha, wa 'adadal-ahya'i wal-amwat, wa 'adada ma azlama 'alayhil-laylu wa ashraqa 'alayhin-nahar, wa 'adada man yamshi 'ala rijlayni wa man yamshi 'ala arba'in, min yawmi khalaqtad-dunya ila yawmil-qiyamah.

items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ مَنْ صَلَّى عَلَيْهِ مِنَ الْجِنِّ وَالْإِنْسِ وَالْمَلَائِكَةِ، وَعَدَدَ مَنْ يُصَلِّي عَلَيْهِ وَعَدَدَ مَنْ لَمْ يُصَلِّ عَلَيْهِ، كَمَا يَجِبُ أَنْ يُصَلَّى عَلَيْهِ وَكَمَا يَنْبَغِي أَنْ يُصَلَّى عَلَيْهِ، حَتَّى لَا يَبْقَى شَيْءٌ مِنَ الصَّلَاةِ عَلَيْهِ، وَصَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ فِي الْأَوَّلِينَ وَفِي الْآخِرِينَ وَفِي الْمَلَإِ الْأَعْلَى إِلَى يَوْمِ الدِّينِ، مَا شَاءَ اللَّهُ لَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ الْعَلِيِّ الْعَظِيمِ.
items.en: O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad and upon the family of our master Muhammad, as many as those among jinn, humans, and angels who have sent blessings upon him, and as many as those who send blessings upon him and as many as those who do not, as blessings are due upon him and as it is fitting that blessings be sent upon him, until nothing of blessing upon him remains, and send blessings upon our master Muhammad among the first and among the last and in the Highest Assembly until the Day of Judgment. What Allah wills; there is no power except in Allah, the Most High, the Exalted.
items.translit: Allahumma salli 'ala Sayyidina Muhammadin wa 'ala ali Sayyidina Muhammadin 'adada man salla 'alayhi minal-jinni wal-insi wal-mala'ikah, wa 'adada man yusalli 'alayhi wa 'adada man lam yusalli 'alayh, kama yajibu an yusalla 'alayhi wa kama yambaghi an yusalla 'alayh, hatta la yabqa shay'un minas-salati 'alayh, wa salli 'ala Sayyidina Muhammadin fil-awwalina wa fil-akhirina wa fil-mala'il-a'la ila yawmid-din, ma sha'allahu la quwwata illa billahil-'aliyyil-'azim.
